mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its 1-year moving average compresses discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate an economic contraction, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where GDPC1 growth rate < 0 and UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%) signals impending monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 5.0% and the economy is in late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO growth rate < 0.

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST < 600.0) signal weak residential demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 600.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weak payroll growth (PAYEMS growth rate < 0.5%) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) indicate a deteriorating labor market, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS growth rate < 0.5% and UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.
